description: Basal-strength boundary traces: (a) MohrCoulombPointwise sample grids for effective pressure N_till, yield stress tauc = c0 + tan(phi) N_till, and the till_friction_angle inverse (round-trip); (b) drag/drag_with_derivative of the three basal resistance laws (plastic, pseudo-plastic, regularized Coulomb) over (tauc, vx, vy) grids spanning zero/slow/fast sliding; (c) a tauc map computed by the actual MohrCoulombYieldStress component on the verification test-F exact geometry (flat bed, thickness = exact H, Mx=My=31) with a prescribed smooth till-water-thickness field and a prescribed till-friction-angle field.

regenerate.note: Run from the repo root. Override grid with -Mx/-My and output with -dumps_dir. (The other drivers' run configs say 'cd stage1 && ...'; that path prefix is wrong for -dumps_dir, which is relative to the working directory -- the README regenerating block runs everything from the repo root.)

domain.note: 2-D grid only (no vertical levels needed for the basal boundary)

sample_grids.water_thickness_note: W_till_max = hydrology.tillwat_max = 2 m; one negative value exercises the formula (hydrology normally keeps W >= 0); W > Wmax exercises the saturated regime

setup.default_config: mohr_coulomb (basal_yield_stress.model), all basal_yield_stress.* / basal_resistance.* config keys at their defaults

tauc_map_forcing.geometry: test-F exact: bed = 0, sea level = 0, thickness = exactFG(t=0).H for r < 750 km, 0 outside
tauc_map_forcing.W_till: W_till_max * (r/L)^2 (0 at the dome -> saturated 2 m at the margin)
tauc_map_forcing.phi: 20 + 10 cos(pi r/L) deg (30 at the dome -> 10 at the margin)

dump_files.meta.txt: pism revision, config file, component, grid, command line
dump_files.parameters.csv: basal_yield_stress.*, basal_resistance.*, hydrology.tillwat_max, constants.*, grid.* config keys
dump_files.effective_pressure.csv: delta, P_overburden, water_thickness -> N_interior (un-clamped), N_till = min(P, N_interior)
dump_files.yield_stress.csv: delta, P_overburden, water_thickness, phi_deg -> N_till, tauc = c0 + tan(phi) N_till
dump_files.till_friction_angle.csv: round trip: phi -> tauc -> phi_inverse (inverse of yield_stress, must be exact)
dump_files.drag_plastic.csv: tauc, vx, vy -> beta, dbeta, dbeta_fd (central difference w.r.t. alpha = 0.5|v|^2), |tau_b|
dump_files.inputs.nc: test-F geometry + forcing (usurf, thk, topg, mask, sea_level, till_water_thickness, subglacial_water_thickness, no_model_mask, tillphi) + outputs (tauc, N_till)
dump_files.tauc_map.csv: per cell: geometry, W_till, phi, delta, P_overburden, N_till (recomputed), tauc

checks.N_till_dry: N_till(0.02, 1e7 Pa, W=0) = 1e7 Pa = P_overburden (min clamps the huge dry-till value)
checks.N_till_Whalf: N_till(0.02, 1e7 Pa, W=Wmax/2) = 1e7 Pa (still saturated at P=1e7; interior drops below P only for W >~ 1.4 m)
checks.N_till_monotone: N_till non-increasing in water_thickness over the whole sample grid
checks.plastic_drag: beta(1e5, 0, 0) = 3.15569e14 Pa s m^-1 = tauc/eps (eps = plastic.regularization = 0.01 m/yr); beta(1e5, 1e-4 m/s, 0) = 1e9 Pa s m^-1 with |tau_b| = beta*|v| = 1e5 = tauc (plastic limit)
checks.drag_derivative: max |dbeta_fd - dbeta|/|dbeta| ~ 1e-10 for all three laws (drag_with_derivative consistent with the finite-difference derivative w.r.t. alpha = 0.5|v|^2)
checks.drag_direction_invariance: beta depends only on |v|: max beta spread across the 4 sampled directions ~ 1e-5 (round-off relative to beta)
checks.tauc_map_grounded_range: grounded tauc range [11850.4, 15462190.636559313] Pa: smallest at the margin (thin ice + saturated till), largest at the dome
checks.tauc_map_dome: dome center (H = 3000 m): P = N_till = 2.67813e7 Pa (W_till ~ 0), phi = 30 deg, tauc = 15462190.636559313 Pa = tan(30 deg) * N_till + c0
